Directories

Add external programs to open any file. Use {file} as a placeholder — if omitted, the file is passed as the last argument. Examples: gimp {file}, code {file}, evince {file}.

Compare this device with another one and exchange the files and tags you are missing. Start “Sharing” on the other device first.

Share every document carrying a tag — either as a bundle file or straight to another device on the network.

Your documents are always encrypted at rest and kept in the app’s own private storage directory — never next to the executable.

A passphrase wraps the archive key with Argon2id. The passphrase itself is never written to disk.
